result.instructions: Tools for Wellknown, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which treatment slots are still free next Saturday?"; "Show the bookings that changed in the last 2 days."; "Close the venue on 25 December and open 10:00 to 14:00 on 24 December.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Wellknown data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wellknown_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wellknown_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wellknown_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. wellknown_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wellknown_get_venue
tools.title: Get venue
tools.description: Get the venue profile: name, market (uk/us), currency, timezone, slot and buffer minutes, lead hours, opening hours per weekday, cancellation rules and treatments. Good first call. Wellknown API: GET /venue/.

tools.name: wellknown_list_treatments
tools.title: List treatments
tools.description: List the venue's treatments with id, name, kind, duration, price per person (minor units), max guests, capacity and peak-date seasons. Wellknown API: GET /treatments/.

tools.name: wellknown_get_availability
tools.title: Get free times
tools.description: Get the free time slots Wellknown sells, per treatment per day (time, end, places free). Up to 31 days per call; `to` is exclusive. Wellknown API: GET /availability/.

to.description: End day, yyyy-mm-dd (exclusive). At most 31 days after `from`.

tools.name: wellknown_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings changed since a timestamp (the updatedAt high-water mark). Bookings are already paid in full. Output holds customer contact data and guest health answers: treat them as sensitive. Wellknown API: GET /bookings/.

since.description: ISO timestamp, for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Omit for the default window.

tools.name: wellknown_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking by reference (for example WK-7KQ2MD): status (confirmed, checked in, completed, cancelled), treatment, guests, date, times, customer and money fields in minor units. Contains sensitive health answers. Wellknown API: GET /bookings/{ref}/.

tools.name: wellknown_set_date_hours
tools.title: Set hours for single dates
tools.description: WRITE. Change opening hours for single dates on Wellknown. Per day: opens + closes (HH:MM), or closed true, or only the date to go back to normal hours. Changes what customers can book. Wellknown API: PUT /availability/.

closed.description: true closes the venue that day.

tools.name: wellknown_replace_blocks
tools.title: Replace blocked times
tools.description: WRITE, FULL REPLACE. Set the times the venue's own appointments take, so Wellknown never double-books. Every block NOT sent is removed. units = places taken from every treatment; units 0 closes the whole venue for that time. Wellknown API: PUT /blocks/.

id.description: Your own stable id for the block.

units.description: Places taken per treatment. 0 = venue closed.

blocks.description: The COMPLETE list of blocks. An empty list removes all blocks.
